entities.summary: Riccardo Moizo was an Italian aviation pioneer in the early part of the 20th century and a general during World War II. He was Commander-General of the Carabinieri from 1935 to 1940 and the last High Commissioner of the Province of Ljubljana in 1943; from 1939 to 1943 he was also a member of the Italian Senate.
